en: Vintage sepia postcard showing an ornate interior with intricate geometric tilework, arches, and columns in an Arab-Moorish style. A large circular mosaic fountain dominates the left side, with a person in traditional robe standing beside it. Another figure sits on the tiled floor in the foreground. The architectural setting appears to be a historic interior in the medina of Fez. Printed caption text in French and a photographer/editor credit appear at the bottom.
